readonlyEditor: Preview mode is on; switch back to editing before saving
workspaceReadonly: SiYuan is running in read-only mode, so this file cannot be edited here
tooLarge: The file is {size}, over the {limit} MB limit of this plugin. Open it with the system default application from the link's context menu instead
restoreBody: This file had unsaved changes when its tab was last closed. Restore them, or load the file as it is on disk?
closeBody: {file} has unsaved changes. Save them before closing?
takeover: Open asset text files in a tab
takeoverTip: Clicking a link to a whitelisted text file opens it in this editor instead of the system default application. Other gestures are left to SiYuan
takeoverGestureTip: Which click opens the editor. The remaining gestures keep SiYuan's own behaviour, so Alt or Shift click still opens the system default application and Ctrl click still reveals the file
extensionsTip: Only links to assets with these extensions are opened here. One per line, or separated by commas or spaces
maxSizeTip: Files larger than this are not opened here; the tab explains why and points at the context menu entry for opening them externally
confirmOnCloseTip: Ask before closing a tab that has unsaved changes. Closing the whole SiYuan window cannot be intercepted; unsaved changes are stashed instead
stashUnsavedTip: Keep unsaved content when a tab closes, and offer to restore it the next time the same file is opened
openModeTip: Which mode a newly opened tab starts in. Preview is read-only; the button in the action bar switches back to editing at any time. Tabs that are already open are unaffected
lineNumbersTip: Whether the gutter shows line numbers
restoreCursorTip: Return to the previous scroll position and cursor when the same file is reopened
forgetTip: Remembers the language chosen per file, the cursor position, and stashed changes
settingsFailed: Settings could not be written to the workspace
